title: Read the north road and the north sites: Atria (the north outpost), the road by Regor, Groombridge 34, Chalawan and Rasalhague to Yildun (the station candidate), Aldebaran, Hawthorne, Alchiba and their neighbours, every three hours
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-17 19:26 UTC for orders.log ENT-042 (block ORACLE, P4 b): about ten scouts explore the north (Aldebaran to Alchiba) and the south (Biham, Felis) first, for the next sites, and the report names the candidates 3 or 4 systems out with their fields, lanes and pirate record (rule F33). The list: every system within two lanes of Aldebaran, Yildun, Hawthorne and Alchiba (table lanes), taken from census-roads so that no system stands on two lists of ours; nearest to home first. They lie 5 to 13 systems beyond our border and 7 to 15 jumps from home; their reads were 4.8 to 7 hours old at the turn of 19:15 UTC (table places). The near tier of the north (Nightveil, GSC-0049, Denebola at 3 systems out, Acrab and Marfik at 4) stays on census-frontier and census-worked. No station with fuel and a market stands in the region (table stations: two ENDL outposts and a HEXC outpost), so a trip starts and ends at home; `chain` 3 within two lanes reads up to four systems a trip; tank 95 against about 40 jumps for the farthest trip. Every 180 minutes so that each system is read twice in a turn of four hours (the threshold is the floor of a gap). Five ships: four explorers and the scout with a survey scanner, which surveys each system it reads (census.py). An empty hold (rule F13); a pirate met is filed for Military (observe.py), the scout reads and leaves (rule F27). 2026-11-17 23:23 UTC: orders ENT-052 chose Atria for the north outpost and Yildun as the station candidate and ask Atria, Yildun, the road between them and their neighbours read every three hours with the pirate record of the choke point. Atria, Regor and Groombridge 34 (571 to 630 minutes old at the check of this turn) and Innes 40 came from census-roads; every 150 minutes, since at 180 the ages reached 209 (a threshold is the floor of a gap); six ships.
